npc_keeper_orin.speaker: Keeper Orin
npc_keeper_orin.text: The hearth keeps a place for every honest rest. Return in the morning and we will read the trail together.

npc_keeper_orin.speaker: Keeper Orin
npc_keeper_orin.text: Pip found a quiet path beyond the dew. Your Moonmoth may notice what ours missed.

npc_pip.speaker: Pip
npc_pip.text: Dew gathers under the blue caps. Step lightly and it will stay bright.

npc_mara.speaker: Mara
npc_mara.text: The rise changes with every cloud. A compass helps, but a patient eye helps more.
